paite: "TOUPA aw, hon sualte nang sual in; hon doute nang dou in.
heading: David La / Panpihna Ngetna
english: By David. Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

paite: Phaw neu leh phaw lian la inla, hon panpih ding in dingh in.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

paite: Tei leng phawi inla, hon delhte lam na dal in; ka hinna kiang ah, na hondampa ka hi," chi in.
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

paite: "Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte zahlaksak a hihzum in om uhen, hon hihsiatna ding a thubawlte taizaksak in gen ding thei lou hial in om uhen.
english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

paite: Buhsi huih mutleng bang in om uhenla, TOUPA angel in delhzui zel hen.
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.

paite: Alampi uh mialtak leh naltak hi henla, TOUPA angel in gawt hen.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.

paite: "Aziak om lou in hon matna ding un alen uh kokhuk ah aphahgu ua, aziak om lou in ka hinna kiakna ding in kokhuk atou uhi.
english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

paite: Akigin louh lai in atung uah siatna tung henla; alen phahguk ah amah mah awk henla, huai ah kesia hen.
english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

paite: "Huchi in ka hinna TOUPA ah anuam ding hi; ahotdamna ah akipak ding.
english: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

paite: Ka guh tengteng in, TOUPA, migenthei nan zoh vual louh lak a humbitpa ahi, tagah leh genthei, ahihgampa a pan humbitpa, nang bang kua a om?" achi ding uhi.
english: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

paite: "Theihpih diktat lou hialte ahong ding ua; ka thil theih het louh thute ahon dong uhi.
english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

paite: Ka hinna in mansuah khop in thil hoih thil sia in ahon din hi.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

paite: Ke'n bel, adam louh lai un, ka puansilh sai-ip ahi a; ka hinna an ngawl in ka hihgenthei ngal a; ka thumna keimah angsung ngei ah ahong kik nawn hi.
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

paite: Ka lawm hiam, ka unau hiam leng hi heh aw atung ua ka omdan ding bang in ahi ka om; mi anu kah bang in suun in ka kun hi.
english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

paite: "Himahleh kei ka bai leh amau akipak ua, akikhawm hial ua; mivuak hatte hon sual ding in akikhawm ua, huai ka na thei ngal kei a, tawp nuam lou in ahon hih ek uhi.
english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

paite: Ankuangluina a chiamnuih gente bang phet in aha uh ahon gawikhum uhi.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

paite: "TOUPA, nang bang tan ahia na et ding? Ka hinna hihsiat atupna lak uah hon hunkhia inla, ka neihsun pen humpinelkai lak ah honkhia in.
english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

paite: Kikhopna thupitak ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; mi tampi lak ah ka hon phat ding hi.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

paite: "Ka melmate'n dikloutak ah hon otsan kei uhen; bangmah lou a hon hote leng amit un kihoupih sam kei uhen.
english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

paite: "Kituahna thu himhim agen ngal kei ua, hiai gam a om hiathiatte khemna thute angaihtuah zaw uhi.
english: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

paite: Ahi, akam un hon kam kat khum ua; Ku! Ku! I mit in i muta achi uhi.
english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

paite: TOUPA aw, nang na mu hi, daihsan ke'n! TOUPA aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n.
english: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

paite: Ka Pathian leh ka TOUPA aw, ka vaihawm ding in, ahi, ka thu a hong um ding in, kihalhsak inla, hak in.
english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, na diktatna bang zel in vai hon hawmsak inla; amaute'n hon otsan kei uhen.
english: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

paite: Alungsim un, Nuam e! Huchibang akei maw i deih, chi kei uhen. Amah i valh khinta, chi sam kei uhen.
english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

paite: "Ka siatna tung a kipakte zahlak leh gen ding bei in om chiat uhenla; ka tung a kiliansakte zahlakna leh zumna silhsak in om uhen.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

paite: Ka diktatna tung a kipakte nuam a kikou in kipaktak in om uhenla, Ahi, asikha vangphatna a kipakte'n TOUPA pahtawi in om hen, chi gige uhen.
english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

paite: Huchi in ka lei in na diktatna thu agen ding a, na phatna thu nitum in agen ding hi."
english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
